annotation.title_clean: Principes pour des technologies de l’intelligence artificielle (IA) générative responsables, dignes de confiance et respectueuses de la vie privée
annotation.title_en: Principles for responsible, trustworthy and privacy-protective generative AI technologies
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Commissariat à la protection de la vie privée du Canada (with provincial and territorial privacy commissioners)
annotation.venue: Commissariat à la protection de la vie privée du Canada (priv.gc.ca)
annotation.summary_en: Joint guidance from Canada's federal, provincial and territorial privacy commissioners applying key privacy principles to generative AI. It addresses developers, providers and users, covering lawful basis, transparency, accountability, safety and vulnerable groups, and stresses that generative AI remains subject to existing privacy laws.
key_provisions_or_claims: Generative AI is not exempt from existing Canadian privacy laws.
Separate expectations for developers/providers and organisations using generative AI.
Requires privacy impact assessments and accountability structures.
Organisations must disclose AI use in decision-making and to users of public tools.
Special attention to children and groups vulnerable to bias; training data must be assessed for bias.
